verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents creating teams, inviting members and assigning them roles. It also documents scoped API keys that can be created, scoped, rotated and revoked, and transferring credit into a team. However, the docs describe role permissions and per-member or per-key spend controls only thinly, so credential and spend governance is partly evidenced. Missing for 10: details of role permission granularity, per-member or per-key spend limits or budgets, team-scoped key management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: This quickstart guide will walk you through how to create a team, invite new team members and assign them to different roles.
Create, scope, rotate, and revoke Vast.ai API keys for the CLI, SDK, and REST API.
For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.
To add credit during team creation, select Transfer my personal credits checkbox, enter an amount, and then click Create.
